name: aee-walkthrough-video
description: Revideo-based walkthrough video lane for Agent Studio journeys (audio-driven, Variant C). Self-contained sub-project so the heavy @revideo deps only install for the video CI job, not the normal e2e run.

scripts.render:example: npm run prep:clips && cross-env DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true node --import tsx revideo/render.ts example-variant-c example-variant-c.mp4
scripts.render:team-setup: npm run prep:shots && npm run prep:audio && cross-env DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true node --import tsx revideo/render.ts example-team-setup team-setup-walkthrough.mp4 && node scripts/mux-narration.mjs out/final/team-setup-walkthrough.mp4 out/final/team-setup-walkthrough.mp4 scripts/team-setup.narration.json
scripts.render:iban-story: npm run prep:shots && npm run prep:audio && cross-env DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true node --import tsx revideo/render.ts example-iban-story iban-story-walkthrough.mp4 && node scripts/mux-narration.mjs out/final/iban-story-walkthrough.mp4 out/final/iban-story-walkthrough.mp4 scripts/iban-story.narration.json
